summary: Frontend-only testing for the new course poster/brochure feature in the PaymentSection. All 11 targeted checks passed: F&O poster renders by default with correct testid, naturalWidth>0 (853), header 'Course Brochure' visible, 'View full size' link has target=_blank and href containing /course-fno-mastery.jpg. Switching to Stock Market course swaps posters correctly (F&O removed, SM poster loaded naturalWidth=853, href contains /course-stock-market.jpg). Switching back restores F&O; no duplicates. Image uses w-full class (correct aspect). coupon-hints element remains removed. No console errors from poster loading.
critical_code_review_comments: Posters are large JPGs (loaded fine, ~500ms). Consider adding loading="lazy" and width/height attributes on to improve CLS and perf (minor).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Note the app is served under basename /tradingbull/, so public asset hrefs appear as /tradingbull/course-fno-mastery.jpg. The requirement 'href matches /course-fno-mastery.jpg' is satisfied as substring match. Payment-section elements (pay button, QR, WhatsApp) visually render; their exact testids were not verified in this run but prior iterations covered them.
